build.description: Default coding agent with full tool access.

plan.description: Planning-only agent that asks before edits or shell commands.

general.description: General-purpose subagent for broad research and multi-step work.

explore.description: Read-only subagent for fast codebase exploration.

dotfiles.description: Dotfiles specialist. Edits shell config, aliases, functions, tmux, nvim, and tool configs in ~/.dotfiles. Always guards interactive-only aliases with [[ -o interactive ]]. Never puts secrets in files tracked by git. Catppuccin Macchiato theme everywhere.

plan-approve.description: Draft a plan and request approval
plan-approve.template: Create a concrete implementation plan for: $ARGUMENTS. Keep it concise, list assumptions, and stop before any code changes. Ask for explicit approval with the exact word APPROVE before proceeding.

review-diff.template: Review the current git diff in this repo. Focus on bugs, regressions, security, missing tests, and rollout risk. Return findings first, ordered by severity, then open questions.

commit-message.template: Analyze the current git changes and produce 3 Conventional Commits only using type(scope): subject (or type!: subject for breaking changes). Include a brief body and explicit BREAKING CHANGE note when applicable.

workspace-setup.description: Scaffold a new project workspace with tmux layout and tooling
workspace-setup.template: Set up a workspace for: $ARGUMENTS. Use agent-workspace or review-workspace tmux layout functions as appropriate. Create a mise.toml if needed with correct runtimes for the project type. Suggest any missing tools from the standard stack (uv, mise, ripgrep, fd, etc.).
